spans.s: --one among the महा-पुरा- णस्; comprises ११,000 श्लोकस्. भा.

--Origin of; came out of a ball of ever-burning fire and grew and grew; विष्णु and ब्रह्मा undertook to find out its beginning and the end. It was all effulgence. They found it impossible and prayed to शिव who initiated them into माहेश्वरम् बलम्।
1: Br. II. २६. २१ to the end; २७. ३०-101; वा. ५५. २१-61.
Establishment of the cult in the presence of शिव and the sages; is जीव, mahat; leads to kaivalya;
2: Br.

. २२, ५६-9, ७९.
found in गोदावरी;
3: M. २२. ५७.
worship of at Benares relieves one of rebirth;
4: Ib. १५४. ३५०; १८५. ५७.
its size for installation in the palace depends on the measurement of the palace; nine varieties are distinguished. The technique of the making of a [page३-122+ २३] Linga is furnished in detail. It may be of gems, स्पटिक, of stone, earth, or wood.
5: Ib. २६३. 1, ११, २५.
--गदाधर became turned to Linga in Kaliyuga; a प्रपितामह. वा. १११. ८४.
--a sacred place on the नर्मदा. M. १९१. ५१-2.
